body: 13 Nov 2026 19:25 UTC, CORRECTION of points 1 and 3 of the note of the same evening: the server image DOES publish from the public repo. The first run on this repository (push of #6 to main, 19:20) built the image and pushed it: all steps green, package ghcr.io/appayiipyiip/encore-server updated 19:23 (234 versions). So writes work and there is NO package click left for the owner; my earlier statements that server-image would return 403 until he added the repository, and that nothing merged could be marked walked before that, were wrong and are withdrawn. What stands: the package is still PRIVATE and still linked to the OLD private repository (its 231 older versions were built from the unscrubbed source), so it is never made public before those versions are scanned or deleted (trigger: the install-by-clicking item that needs a stranger to pull the image). A release-candidate pair now needs the matching APK: the App workflow's android-debug-build job on the same main commit (it never finished yet: every merge to main cancels the previous run; one run must be left to finish) and a walk on an emulator plus VM 108 on the new :main, never on the owner's phone (a different signature would cost him his downloads). Also checked: goldens.yml is workflow_dispatch only (it redraws the Linux pictures on a branch after a deliberate screen change and commits them back: not needed now, the App job compares against them and passes); server-legacy.yml runs only when server/legacy/** changes.
